caption: The drawing features a circular design with a blue and white color scheme, centered on a depiction of a multi-story neoclassical building with arched windows and a prominent central spire, identified as the "Temple at Nauvoo." Above the building, there are clouds in the sky. Encircling the building is the text: "THE HOUSE OF THE LORD BUILT BY THE CHURCH OF JESUS CHRIST OF LATTER DAY SAINTS (COMMENCED APRIL 6TH AD 1841 - HOLINESS TO THE LORD)." Around this inner text, there is a decorative patterned border, which is further encircled by another ring of text containing the names of individuals such as "PRESIDENT BRIGHAM YOUNG," "HEBER C. KIMBALL," "ORSON HYDE," and several others written in uppercase letters. The entire design is centered on a plain, off-white background with no additional ornamentation or objects outside the circular motif. In the lower right of the page, the name "JOHN KOSEL" appears in faint, small letters.
title: Plate
